licence: Texts written by the Vibecode my car project in its own words from general automotive knowledge (CC0 1.0). Not copied from SAE J2012 or from any GPL code list. Code structure (letter, generic/manufacturer digit, subsystem digit) follows the publicly described SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 layout.
unknown_generic: Generic code; its description is not in the Vibecode my car table yet.
unknown_manufacturer: Manufacturer-specific code: meaning unknown without the manufacturer's documentation.
